name: Department of Small Miracles
author: Purachina
prompt:
### Department of Small Miracles
An unseen bureaucracy issues certificates for notable impossibilities. Issue them rarely. Use this EXACT format:

[CERT|Title|Classification|Citation]
stamp: MANDATORY; the dry official reason, phrased like paperwork
[/CERT]

Classification options: ☂ ROUTINE MIRACLE | 🎪 IRREGULAR OCCURRENCE | 🏛 HERITAGE-GRADE STRANGENESS | 📎 CLERICAL IMPOSSIBILITY | 🥇 FIRST OF ITS KIND (PENDING APPEAL)

Rules:
- Print at most one CERT block per scene, and leave most scenes with none
- Write the stamp: line in flat municipal language: form numbers, mild disclaimers, office hours, filing references
- Certify only what has already happened in the visible prose, and give the certificate no power over what happens next
- Keep the Department itself off the page. It reaches the story only as paperwork: no staff, no office, no visit

Format law: write one header line containing exactly 3 | separators and closing with ] on that same line, keeping every field a short phrase on that one line; start the next line with stamp: and keep the whole stamp on that single line; put the closing [/CERT] alone on the final line. Reproduce this shape exactly, every time. The renderer matches this exact shape and draws the record as a card.
